summary: Iteration 8 verified the new enhancement batch end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (/api/commissions/pay per-item PO validation with no partial apply, distinct PO persistence, /commissions/unpay, /commissions/paid/pdf with salesman_name + date_from/date_to, role scoping for salesman, auth required, /invoices & /dashboard shape). Frontend (admin chrisjacker@gmail.com): per-commission PO dialog shows one pay-po-<id> input per selected row; blank PO shows 'Enter a PO number for every commission' toast and marks nothing; two distinct POs persist and render as distinct comm-po-<id> chips on the Paid tab (no checkboxes on Paid tab as designed); paid date filter narrows rows and out-of-range shows the empty message; Export PDF issues GET /api/commissions/paid/pdf?date_from&date_to and downloads paid-commissions.pdf; By-salesman export button issues ?salesman_name=Sam+Salesman and downloads paid-commissions-sam-salesman.pdf. Dashboard drill-downs all work: receivable-link -> /receivables?filter=overdue with red Overdue toggle active and only OVERDUE rows (3 of 9 open), payable-link -> /payables, collected-link -> /receivables, and all five mini-stats navigate correctly. Receivables All/Overdue toggle syncs the URL query param both ways and direct landing on ?filter=overdue starts in Overdue mode. All commissions marked paid during testing were restored via POST /api/commissions/unpay (verified 43 unpaid rows before and after).

issues: Many rows show customer as 'Unknown' and estimates titled 'TEST_Tier Estimate' / 'TEST_Chain Tier1' — leftover records from earlier automated test iterations pollute the demo dataset (43 unpaid commission rows). Cosmetic only, but the demo looks noisy; consider a cleanup of TEST_-prefixed estimates/invoices and orphaned customer references.

action_items: Optional: purge leftover TEST_-prefixed estimates/invoices and rows whose customer resolves to 'Unknown' so demo data reads cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py pay_commissions() silently skips items with invalid ObjectId (continue) and reports only modified_count — a client sending a bad id gets 200 with a lower 'updated' count and no error. Consider 400 on unknown/invalid ids for parity with the all-or-nothing PO validation.

Commissions.jsx paid-date filter treats rows with an empty paid_at as always in-range (d falsy short-circuits both comparisons); harmless today since paid rows always have paid_at, but worth an explicit guard.
server.py is ~2695 lines — over the 700-line guidance; consider splitting routers (commissions, receivables, pdf builders) into modules.
